英摘: Out-of-distribution (OOD) detection is an indispensable aspect of secure AI when deploying machine learning models in real-world applications. Previous paradigms either explore better scoring functions or utilize the knowledge of outliers to equip the models with the ability of OOD detection. However, few of them pay attention to the intrinsic OOD detection capability of the given model. In this work, we generally discover the existence of an intermediate stage of a model trained on in-distribution (ID) data having higher OOD detection performance than that of its final stage across different settings, and further identify one critical data-level attribution to be learning with the atypical samples. 中摘: 在将机器学习模型部署于实际应用中的安全人工智能领域，分布外（OOD）检测是不可或缺的一环。以往的方法要么探索更优的评分函数，要么利用异常值的知识来赋予模型OOD检测的能力。然而，鲜有方法关注给定模型本身固有的OOD检测能力。在本项工作中，我们普遍发现，在不同设置下，模型在训练至分布内（ID）数据的中间阶段时，其OOD检测性能高于其最终阶段。进一步地，我们确定了一个关键的数据层面因素，即与非典型样本的学习。基于这些见解，我们提出了一种新颖的方法，称为“释放掩码”，旨在通过使用ID数据训练良好的模型恢复其OOD辨别能力。我们的方法利用一个掩码来识别被记住的非典型样本，然后通过引入的掩码对模型进行微调或剪枝，以忘记这些样本。广泛的实验和分析证明了我们方法的有效性。代码可在以下网址获取：https://github.com/tmlr-group/Unleashing-Mask。

[No.677] Unsupervised Out-of-Distribution Detection with Diffusion Inpainting
来源: ICML 2023
命中: detect
标题: 无监督的分布外检测与扩散补全
类别: 
作者: Zhenzhen Liu;Jin Peng Zhou;Yufan Wang;Kilian Q Weinberger;
机构: Cornell University;ASAPP Inc.;
类型: Poster
链接: https://icml.cc/virtual/2023/poster/23466
arXi: https://arxiv.org/abs/2302.10326
英摘: Unsupervised out-of-distribution detection (OOD) seeks to identify out-of-domain data by learning only from unlabeled in-domain data. We present a novel approach for this task - Lift, Map, Detect (LMD) - that leverages recent advancement in diffusion models. Diffusion models are one type of generative models. At their core, they learn an iterative denoising process that gradually maps a noisy image closer to their training manifolds. LMD leverages this intuition for OOD detection. Specifically, LMD lifts an image off its original manifold by corrupting it, and maps it towards the in-domain manifold with a diffusion model. For an out-of-domain image, the mapped image would have a large distance away from its original manifold, and LMD would identify it as OOD accordingly. We show through extensive experiments that LMD achieves competitive performance across a broad variety of datasets. Code can be found at https://github.com/zhenzhel/lift_map_detect.
中摘: 无监督的异常分布检测（OOD）旨在仅从无标签的领域内数据学习来识别领域外数据。我们提出了一种针对此任务的新方法——提升、映射、检测（LMD），该方法利用了最近在扩散模型领域的进展。扩散模型是一种生成模型。其核心在于，它们学习了一个迭代去噪过程，逐渐将噪声图像映射到训练流形附近。LMD 利用这一直觉进行 OOD 检测。具体来说，LMD 通过破坏图像将其从原始流形上“提升”起来，并使用扩散模型将其映射到领域内流形。对于领域外图像，映射后的图像与其原始流形之间的距离会很大，LMD 将据此识别其为 OOD。我们通过大量实验表明，LMD 在各种数据集上均取得了具有竞争力的表现。代码可在以下链接找到：https://github.com/zhenzhel/lift_map_detect。

In this work, we opine that the influence of token entropy should be fully considered in the watermark detection process, $i.e.$, the weight of each token during watermark detection should be customized according to its entropy, rather than setting the weights of all tokens to the same value as in previous methods. Furthermore, the proposed detection process is training-free and fully automated. From the experiments, we demonstrate that our EWD can achieve better detection performance in low-entropy scenarios, and our method is also general and can be applied to texts with different entropy distributions. Our code and data is available\footnote{\url{https://github.com/luyijian3/EWD}}. Additionally, our algorithm could be accessed through MarkLLM \cite{pan2024markllm}\footnote{\url{https://github.com/THU-BPM/MarkLLM}}.
中摘: 针对大型语言模型（LLMs）的文本水印算法能够通过在文本中嵌入和检测隐藏特征，有效地识别机器生成的文本。尽管当前的文本水印算法在大多数高熵场景下表现良好，但在低熵场景下的性能仍有待提高。在这项工作中，我们认为在水印检测过程中应充分考虑令牌熵的影响，即，在水印检测期间，每个令牌的权重应根据其熵进行定制，而不是像之前的方法那样将所有令牌的权重设置为相同的值。具体来说，我们提出了一种基于熵的文本水印检测方法（\textbf{EWD}），它在水印检测时给予高熵令牌更高的影响力权重，从而更好地反映水印的程度。此外，所提出的检测过程无需训练且完全自动化。从实验中，我们证明了我们的EWD在低熵场景下可以实现更好的检测性能，而且我们的方法具有普适性，可应用于具有不同熵分布的文本。我们的代码和数据可在\footnote{\url{https://github.com/luyijian3/EWD}}获取。此外，我们的算法也可以通过MarkLLM访问\cite{pan2024markllm}\footnote{\url{https://github.com/THU-BPM/MarkLLM}}。

针对大型语言模型的文本水印算法能有效识别出由机器生成的文本，通过在文本中嵌入并检测隐藏特征实现。虽然现有文本水印算法在多数高熵情景下表现优异，但在低熵情景中的性能尚需提升。本研究认为，水印检测过程中应当全面考量令牌熵的影响，即在进行水印检测时，每个令牌的权重应依据其熵值进行个性化调整，而非沿用先前方法将所有令牌权重设定为同一数值。为此，我们创新性地提出了基于熵的文本水印检测方法（\textbf{EWD}），在水印检测阶段赋予高熵令牌更高的影响力权重，以更准确地反映水印程度。值得一提的是，该检测流程无需训练且实现全自动化。通过实验验证，我们的EWD在低熵情景下展现出更佳的检测效能，同时，该方法具备广泛适用性，适用于不同熵分布的文本。我们的代码与数据可于\footnote{\url{https://github.com/luyijian3/EWD}}获取。此外，我们的算法亦可通过MarkLLM\cite{pan2024markllm}\footnote{\url{https://github.com/THU-BPM/MarkLLM}}访问使用。

英摘: The widespread use of large language models (LLMs) has sparked concerns about the potential misuse of AI-generated text, as these models can produce content that closely resembles human-generated text. This paper investigates the robustness of existing AIGT detection methods and introduces a novel detector, the Siamese Calibrated Reconstruction Network (SCRN). Experiments on four publicly available datasets show that the SCRN outperforms all baseline methods, achieving 6.5\%-18.25\% absolute accuracy improvement over the best baseline method under adversarial attacks. [No.695] DELL: Generating Reactions and Explanations for LLM-Based Misinformation Detection
来源: ACL 2024

标题: 认知扭曲句子的检测与正向重构： Mandarin 数据集及评估

作者: Shuya Lin;Yuxiong Wang;Jonathan Dong;Shiguang Ni;
机构: Tsinghua University;École polytechnique fédérale de Lausanne;
类型: Findings
链接: https://aclanthology.org/2024.findings-acl.399/
arXi: https://arxiv.org/abs/2405.15334
英摘: This research introduces a Positive Reconstruction Framework based on positive psychology theory. Overcoming negative thoughts can be challenging, our objective is to address and reframe them through a positive reinterpretation. To tackle this challenge, a two-fold approach is necessary: identifying cognitive distortions and suggesting a positively reframed alternative while preserving the original thought's meaning. Recent studies have investigated the application of Natural Language Processing (NLP) models in English for each stage of this process. In this study, we emphasize the theoretical foundation for the Positive Reconstruction Framework, grounded in broaden-and-build theory. We provide a shared corpus containing 4001 instances for detecting cognitive distortions and 1900 instances for positive reconstruction in Mandarin. Leveraging recent NLP techniques, including transfer learning, fine-tuning pretrained networks, and prompt engineering, we demonstrate the effectiveness of automated tools for both tasks. In summary, our study contributes to multilingual positive reconstruction, highlighting the effectiveness of NLP in cognitive distortion detection and positive reconstruction.
中摘: 本研究基于积极心理学理论引入了积极重构框架。克服消极思维具有挑战性，我们的目标是通过积极的重新诠释来解决和重塑这些思维。为了解决这一挑战，需要采取两步法：识别认知扭曲，并在保留原思维意义的同时提出积极的重塑替代方案。近期的研究探讨了自然语言处理（NLP）模型在英语中应用于这一过程各个阶段的应用。在本研究中，我们强调了积极重构框架的理论基础，该框架根植于拓宽-构建理论。我们提供了一个共享语料库，包含4001个用于检测认知扭曲的实例和1900个用于积极重构的普通话实例。利用最近的NLP技术，包括迁移学习、预训练网络微调和提示工程，我们展示了自动化工具在这两项任务中的有效性。总之，我们的研究对多语言的积极重构做出了贡献，突出了NLP在认知扭曲检测和积极重构方面的有效性。

[No.697] Detection-Correction Structure via General Language Model for Grammatical Error Correction
来源: ACL 2024
命中: detect
标题: 基于通用语言模型的检测-修正结构用于语法错误纠正
类别: 
作者: Wei Li;Houfeng Wang;
机构: Peking University;
类型: Long
链接: https://aclanthology.org/2024.acl-long.96/
arXi: https://arxiv.org/abs/2405.17804
英摘: Grammatical error correction (GEC) is a task dedicated to rectifying texts with minimal edits, which can be decoupled into two components: detection and correction. However, previous works have predominantly focused on direct correction, with no prior efforts to integrate both into a single model. Moreover, the exploration of the detection-correction paradigm by large language models (LLMs) remains underdeveloped. This paper introduces an integrated detection-correction structure, named DeCoGLM, based on the General Language Model (GLM). The detection phase employs a fault-tolerant detection template, while the correction phase leverages autoregressive mask infilling for localized error correction. Through the strategic organization of input tokens and modification of attention masks, we facilitate multi-task learning within a single model. Our model demonstrates competitive performance against the state-of-the-art models on English and Chinese GEC datasets. Further experiments present the effectiveness of the detection-correction structure in LLMs, suggesting a promising direction for GEC.
中摘: 语法错误修正（GEC）是一项致力于通过最小化编辑来纠正文本的任务，可以分解为两个组成部分：检测和修正。然而，之前的研究主要集中在直接修正上，没有尝试将两者整合到一个单一模型中。此外，大型语言模型（LLMs）对检测-修正范式的探索仍然不够充分。本文介绍了一种基于通用语言模型（GLM）的集成检测-修正结构，命名为DeCoGLM。检测阶段使用容错检测模板，而修正阶段利用自回归掩码填充进行局部错误修正。通过策略性地组织输入标记并修改注意力掩码，我们实现了在一个模型中的多任务学习。我们的模型在英语和汉语的GEC数据集上展现出与最先进模型相当的表现。进一步的实验展示了LLMs中检测-修正结构的有效性，为GEC指出了一个有前景的方向。

[No.698] Do Pre-Trained Language Models Detect and Understand Semantic Underspecification? Ask the DUST!
来源: ACL 2024
命中: detect
标题: 预训练语言模型能否检测和理解语义欠明确性？问DUST！
类别: 
作者: Frank Wildenburg;Michael Hanna;Sandro Pezzelle;
机构: University of Amsterdam;
类型: Findings
链接: https://aclanthology.org/2024.findings-acl.572/
arXi: https://arxiv.org/abs/2402.12486
英摘: In everyday language use, speakers frequently utter and interpret sentences that are semantically underspecified, namely, whose content is insufficient to fully convey their message or interpret them univocally. For example, to interpret the underspecified sentence "Don't spend too much", which leaves implicit what (not) to spend, additional linguistic context or outside knowledge is needed. In this work, we propose a novel Dataset of semantically Underspecified Sentences grouped by Type (DUST) and use it to study whether pre-trained language models (LMs) correctly identify and interpret underspecified sentences. We find that newer LMs are reasonably able to identify underspecified sentences when explicitly prompted. However, interpreting them correctly is much harder for any LMs. Our experiments show that when interpreting underspecified sentences, LMs exhibit little uncertainty, contrary to what theoretical accounts of underspecification would predict. Overall, our study reveals limitations in current models' processing of sentence semantics and highlights the importance of using naturalistic data and communicative scenarios when evaluating LMs' language capabilities.
中摘: 在日常语言使用中，说话者经常表达和解释语义未充分指定的句子，也就是说，这些句子的内容不足以完全传达其信息或以单一方式解释。例如，要理解语义未充分指定的句子“不要花太多钱”，其中隐含了不（要）花费什么，需要额外的语言上下文或外部知识。在这项工作中，我们提出了一种新型的数据集，即按类型分组的语义未充分指定句子数据集（DUST），并利用它来研究预训练语言模型（LMs）是否能正确识别和解释语义未充分指定的句子。我们发现，较新的LMs在被明确提示时，能够合理地识别语义未充分指定的句子。然而，正确解释它们对任何LMs来说都困难得多。我们的实验表明，在解释语义未充分指定的句子时，LMs表现出的不确定性很小，这与理论上对语义未充分指定的预测相反。总体而言，我们的研究揭示了当前模型处理句子语义的局限性，并强调了在评估LMs的语言能力时使用自然数据和交流场景的重要性。

来源: ACL 2024

标题: DetectGPT 是否充分利用了扰动？将选择性扰动与微调对比学习检测器相结合会更好。

英摘: The burgeoning generative capabilities of large language models (LLMs) have raised growing concerns about abuse, demanding automatic machine-generated text detectors. DetectGPT, a zero-shot metric-based detector, first introduces perturbation and shows great performance improvement. However, in DetectGPT, the random perturbation strategy could introduce noise, and logit regression depends on the threshold, harming the generalizability and applicability of individual or small-batch inputs. Hence, we propose a novel fine-tuned detector, Pecola, bridging metric-based and fine-tuned methods by contrastive learning on selective perturbation. [No.703] Efficient Detection of LLM-generated Texts with a Bayesian Surrogate Model
来源: ACL 2024
命中: detect
标题: 基于贝叶斯替代模型的高效检测生成自大规模语言模型的文字
类别: 
作者: Yibo Miao;Hongcheng Gao;Hao Zhang;Zhijie Deng;
机构: Shanghai Jiao Tong University;University of Chinese Academy of Sciences;University of California, San Diego;
类型: Findings
链接: https://aclanthology.org/2024.findings-acl.366/
arXi: https://arxiv.org/abs/2305.16617
英摘: The detection of machine-generated text, especially from large language models (LLMs), is crucial in preventing serious social problems resulting from their misuse. Some methods train dedicated detectors on specific datasets but fall short in generalizing to unseen test data, while other zero-shot ones often yield suboptimal performance. Although the recent DetectGPT has shown promising detection performance, it suffers from significant inefficiency issues, as detecting a single candidate requires querying the source LLM with hundreds of its perturbations. This paper aims to bridge this gap. Concretely, we propose to incorporate a Bayesian surrogate model, which allows us to select typical samples based on Bayesian uncertainty and interpolate scores from typical samples to other samples, to improve query efficiency. Empirical results demonstrate that our method significantly outperforms existing approaches under a low query budget. Notably, when detecting the text generated by LLaMA family models, our method with just 2 or 3 queries can outperform DetectGPT with 200 queries.
中摘: 检测机器生成的文本，特别是大型语言模型（LLMs）产生的文本，对于防止其误用导致的严重社会问题至关重要。一些方法在特定数据集上训练专门的检测器，但在泛化到未见测试数据方面表现不足，而其他零样本方法通常性能欠佳。尽管近期的DetectGPT在检测性能上显示出有希望的结果，但它面临着显著的效率问题，因为检测单一候选文本需要向源LLM查询数百次其扰动后的版本。本文旨在填补这一空白。具体而言，我们提出引入一个贝叶斯代理模型，它使我们能够根据贝叶斯不确定性选择典型样本，并从典型样本推断出其他样本的分数，以此来提高查询效率。实验结果表明，在低查询预算下，我们的方法显著优于现有方法。值得注意的是，在检测LLaMA家族模型生成的文本时，我们的方法仅需2或3次查询即可超越DetectGPT的200次查询效果。

英摘: Multifaceted ideology detection (MID) aims to detect the ideological leanings of texts towards multiple facets. Previous studies on ideology detection mainly focus on one generic facet and ignore label semantics and explanatory descriptions of ideologies, which are a kind of instructive information and reveal the specific concepts of ideologies. In this paper, we develop a novel concept semantics-enhanced framework for the MID task. Specifically, we propose a bidirectional iterative concept flow (BICo) method to encode multifaceted ideologies. BICo enables the concepts to flow across levels of the schema tree and enriches concept representations with multi-granularity semantics. Extensive experiments on the benchmark dataset show that our approach achieves state-of-the-art performance in MID, including in the cross-topic scenario.

[No.710] Explicating the Implicit: Argument Detection Beyond Sentence Boundaries
来源: ACL 2024
命中: detect
标题: 明言隐意：超越句子边界的情感论辩检测
类别: 
作者: Paul Roit;Aviv Slobodkin;Eran Hirsch;Arie Cattan;Ayal Klein;Valentina Pyatkin;Ido Dagan;
机构: Bar-Ilan University;Allen Institute for Artificial Intelligence;University of Washington;
类型: Long
链接: https://aclanthology.org/2024.acl-long.863/
arXi: https://arxiv.org/abs/2408.04246
英摘: Detecting semantic arguments of a predicate word has been conventionally modeled as a sentence-level task. The typical reader, however, perfectly interprets predicate-argument relations in a much wider context than just the sentence where the predicate was evoked. In this work, we reformulate the problem of argument detection through textual entailment to capture semantic relations across sentence boundaries. We propose a method that tests whether some semantic relation can be inferred from a full passage by first encoding it into a simple and standalone proposition and then testing for entailment against the passage. Our method does not require direct supervision, which is generally absent due to dataset scarcity, but instead builds on existing NLI and sentence-level SRL resources. 英摘: The subjective perception of emotion leads to inconsistent labels from human annotators. 英摘: Detecting non-factual content is a longstanding goal to increase the trustworthiness of large language models (LLMs) generations. Current factuality probes, trained using humanannotated labels, exhibit limited transferability to out-of-distribution content, while online selfconsistency checking imposes extensive computation burden due to the necessity of generating multiple outputs. This paper proposes PINOSE, which trains a probing model on offline self-consistency checking results, thereby circumventing the need for human-annotated data and achieving transferability across diverse data distributions. As the consistency check process is offline, PINOSE reduces the computational burden of generating multiple responses by online consistency verification. Additionally, it examines various aspects of internal states prior to response decoding, contributing to more effective detection of factual inaccuracies. Experiment results on both factuality detection and question answering benchmarks show that PINOSE achieves surpassing results than existing factuality detection methods. Our code and datasets are publicly available on this anonymized repository.
中摘: 检测非事实内容一直是提高大型语言模型（LLM）生成内容可信度的长期目标。当前的事实性检测方法，使用人工标注的数据进行训练，对于分布外的内容展现出了有限的迁移能力，而在线自一致性检查由于需要生成多个输出，导致了巨大的计算负担。本文提出PINOSE，它通过离线自一致性检查的结果来训练探测模型，从而避免了对人工标注数据的需求，并实现了在不同数据分布间的迁移性。由于一致性检查过程是在离线状态下进行的，PINOSE减少了在线一致性验证时生成多个响应的计算负担。此外，它还考察了解码响应前的各种内部状态方面，有助于更有效地检测事实错误。实验结果显示，在事实检测和问答基准测试上，PINOSE的表现超过了现有的事实性检测方法。我们的代码和数据集在这个匿名仓库中公开可用。

标题: 基于临床问卷学习的简单灵活的心理障碍检测建模方法
类别: 
作者: Hoyun Song;Jisu Shin;Huije Lee;Jong Park;
机构: Korea Advanced Institute of Science and Technology;
类型: Long
链接: https://aclanthology.org/2023.acl-long.681/
arXi: https://arxiv.org/abs/2306.02955
英摘: Social media is one of the most highly sought resources for analyzing characteristics of the language by its users. In particular, many researchers utilized various linguistic features of mental health problems from social media. However, existing approaches to detecting mental disorders face critical challenges, such as the scarcity of high-quality data or the trade-off between addressing the complexity of models and presenting interpretable results grounded in expert domain knowledge. To address these challenges, we design a simple but flexible model that preserves domain-based interpretability. We propose a novel approach that captures the semantic meanings directly from the text and compares them to symptom-related descriptions. Experimental results demonstrate that our model outperforms relevant baselines on various mental disorder detection tasks. Our detailed analysis shows that the proposed model is effective at leveraging domain knowledge, transferable to other mental disorders, and providing interpretable detection results.
中摘: 社交媒体是最受追捧的资源之一，用于分析用户语言特征。特别是，许多研究者利用社交媒体上的各种语言特征来探究心理健康问题。然而，现有的检测精神障碍的方法面临着严峻的挑战，如高质量数据的稀缺性，以及在处理模型复杂性和基于专家领域知识呈现可解释结果之间的权衡。为了解决这些挑战，我们设计了一个简单但灵活的模型，该模型保留了基于领域的可解释性。我们提出了一种新颖的方法，直接从文本中捕捉语义含义，并将其与症状相关的描述进行比较。实验结果表明，我们的模型在多种精神障碍检测任务上超越了相关基线。我们的详细分析显示，所提出的模型能够有效地利用领域知识，可以迁移到其他精神障碍，并提供可解释的检测结果。

[No.762] A Unified Evaluation Framework for Novelty Detection and Accommodation in NLP with an Instantiation in Authorship Attribution
来源: ACL 2023
命中: detect
标题: 一种统一的评价框架，用于自然语言处理中的新颖性检测与适应性处理，及其在作者识别中的实例应用
类别: 
作者: Neeraj Varshney;Himanshu Gupta;Eric Robertson;Bing Liu;Chitta Baral;
机构: Arizona State University;PAR Government Systems Corporation;University of Illinois at Chicago;
类型: Findings
链接: https://aclanthology.org/2023.findings-acl.113/
arXi: https://arxiv.org/abs/2305.05079
英摘: State-of-the-art natural language processing models have been shown to achieve remarkable performance in 'closed-world' settings where all the labels in the evaluation set are known at training time. However, in real-world settings, 'novel' instances that do not belong to any known class are often observed. This renders the ability to deal with novelties crucial. To initiate a systematic research in this important area of 'dealing with novelties', we introduce 'NoveltyTask', a multi-stage task to evaluate a system's performance on pipelined novelty 'detection' and 'accommodation' tasks. We provide mathematical formulation of NoveltyTask and instantiate it with the authorship attribution task that pertains to identifying the correct author of a given text. We use Amazon reviews corpus and compile a large dataset (consisting of 250k instances across 200 authors/labels) for NoveltyTask. We conduct comprehensive experiments and explore several baseline methods for the task. Our results show that the methods achieve considerably low performance making the task challenging and leaving sufficient room for improvement. Finally, we believe our work will encourage research in this underexplored area of dealing with novelties, an important step en route to developing robust systems.
中摘: 最先进的自然语言处理模型在“封闭世界”场景中展现出了卓越的表现，其中评估集中的所有标签在训练时都是已知的。然而，在现实世界中，经常会出现不属于任何已知类别的“新颖”实例。这使得处理新颖性成为关键能力。为了启动在这个重要领域——“处理新颖性”的系统性研究，我们引入了“NoveltyTask”，一个分阶段的任务，用于评估系统在连续的新颖性“检测”和“适应”任务上的性能。我们提供了NoveltyTask的数学表述，并以作者归属任务作为实例，该任务涉及识别给定文本的正确作者。我们使用亚马逊评论语料库，并为NoveltyTask编制了一个大型数据集（包含200位作者/标签下的25万条实例）。我们进行了全面的实验，探索了任务的多种基线方法。我们的结果显示，这些方法的性能相当低，使任务具有挑战性，并留有足够的改进空间。最后，我们相信我们的工作将鼓励在处理新颖性的这一未充分探索的领域进行研究，这是开发稳健系统的道路上的重要一步。

[No.763] ActiveAED: A Human in the Loop Improves Annotation Error Detection
来源: ACL 2023
命中: detect
标题: 主动AED：有人参与提高标注错误检测
类别: 
作者: Leon Weber;Barbara Plank;
机构: LMU Munich;Munich Center for Machine Learning;
类型: Findings
链接: https://aclanthology.org/2023.findings-acl.562/
arXi: https://arxiv.org/abs/2305.20045
英摘: Manually annotated datasets are crucial for training and evaluating Natural Language Processing models. However, recent work has discovered that even widely-used benchmark datasets contain a substantial number of erroneous annotations. This problem has been addressed with Annotation Error Detection (AED) models, which can flag such errors for human re-annotation. However, even though many of these AED methods assume a final curation step in which a human annotator decides whether the annotation is erroneous, they have been developed as static models without any human-in-the-loop component. In this work, we propose ActiveAED, an AED method that can detect errors more accurately by repeatedly querying a human for error corrections in its prediction loop. We evaluate ActiveAED on eight datasets spanning five different tasks and find that it leads to improvements over the state of the art on seven of them, with gains of up to six percentage points in average precision.
中摘: 手动标注的数据集对于训练和评估自然语言处理模型至关重要。然而，最近的研究发现，即使是广泛使用的基准数据集中也包含大量错误的标注。这一问题通过注释错误检测（AED）模型得以解决，这些模型可以标记此类错误以供人工重新标注。然而，尽管许多AED方法假设最终会有一个由人工标注员决定标注是否出错的校对步骤，但它们都是作为静态模型开发的，没有任何人机交互的组件。在这项工作中，我们提出了ActiveAED，这是一种AED方法，它可以通过在其预测循环中反复向人类查询错误修正来更准确地检测错误。我们在涵盖五种不同任务的八个数据集上评估了ActiveAED，并发现它在其中七个数据集上的表现超过了现有最佳技术，平均精度提高了高达六个百分点。

[No.764] Adversarial Multi-task Learning for End-to-end Metaphor Detection
来源: ACL 2023
命中: detect
标题: 对抗多任务学习在端到端隐喻检测中的应用
类别: 
作者: Shenglong Zhang;Ying Liu;
机构: Tsinghua University;
类型: Findings
链接: https://aclanthology.org/2023.findings-acl.96/
arXi: https://arxiv.org/abs/2305.16638
英摘: Metaphor detection (MD) suffers from limited training data. In this paper, we started with a linguistic rule called Metaphor Identification Procedure and then proposed a novel multi-task learning framework to transfer knowledge in basic sense discrimination (BSD) to MD. BSD is constructed from word sense disambiguation (WSD), which has copious amounts of data. We leverage adversarial training to align the data distributions of MD and BSD in the same feature space, so task-invariant representations can be learned. 中摘: 隐喻检测（MD）受到训练数据有限的困扰。在本文中，我们从一个名为隐喻识别程序的语言规则出发，然后提出了一种新颖的多任务学习框架，将基本意义辨别（BSD）中的知识转移到MD上。BSD是从词义消歧（WSD）构建的，后者拥有大量的数据。我们利用对抗性训练来在同一特征空间内对齐MD和BSD的数据分布，以便学习到任务不变的表示。为了捕捉精细的对齐模式，我们利用了MD和BSD的多模态结构。我们的方法完全是端到端的，可以缓解MD中的数据稀缺问题。我们在四个公开数据集上报告了有竞争力的结果。我们的代码和数据集都是可用的。

英摘: A series of datasets and models have been proposed for summaries generated for well-formatted documents such as news articles. Dialogue summaries, however, have been under explored. In this paper, we present the first dataset with fine-grained factual error annotations named DIASUMFACT. [No.766] AoM: Detecting Aspect-oriented Information for Multimodal Aspect-Based Sentiment Analysis
来源: ACL 2023
命中: detect
标题: 面向aspect的Information检测用于多模态Aspect-Based情感分析
类别: 
作者: Ru Zhou;Wenya Guo;Xumeng Liu;Shenglong Yu;Ying Zhang;Xiaojie Yuan;
机构: Nankai University;
类型: Findings
链接: https://aclanthology.org/2023.findings-acl.519/
arXi: https://arxiv.org/abs/2306.01004
英摘: Multimodal aspect-based sentiment analysis (MABSA) aims to extract aspects from text-image pairs and recognize their sentiments. Existing methods make great efforts to align the whole image to corresponding aspects. However, different regions of the image may relate to different aspects in the same sentence, and coarsely establishing image-aspect alignment will introduce noise to aspect-based sentiment analysis (i.e., visual noise). Besides, the sentiment of a specific aspect can also be interfered by descriptions of other aspects (i.e., textual noise). Considering the aforementioned noises, this paper proposes an Aspect-oriented Method (AoM) to detect aspect-relevant semantic and sentiment information. Specifically, an aspect-aware attention module is designed to simultaneously select textual tokens and image blocks that are semantically related to the aspects. To accurately aggregate sentiment information, we explicitly introduce sentiment embedding into AoM, and use a graph convolutional network to model the vision-text and text-text interaction. Extensive experiments demonstrate the superiority of AoM to existing methods. The source code is publicly released at https://github.com/SilyRab/AoM.
中摘: 多模态基于方面的情感分析（MABSA）旨在从文本-图像对中提取方面并识别它们的情感。现有方法努力将整个图像与相应的方面进行对齐。然而，图像的不同区域可能与同一句子中的不同方面相关，粗略地建立图像-方面对齐会为基于方面的 sentiment analysis 引入噪音（即视觉噪音）。此外，特定方面的 sentiment 也可能受到其他方面描述的干扰（即文本噪音）。考虑到上述噪音，本文提出了一种面向方面的 方法（AoM），用于检测与方面相关的语义和 sentiment 信息。具体而言，设计了一个方面感知注意力模块，同时选择与方面在语义上相关的文本标记和图像块。为了准确聚合 sentiment 信息，我们明确地将 sentiment 嵌入引入到 AoM 中，并使用图卷积网络来建模视觉-文本和文本-文本交互。广泛的实验表明 AoM 相对于现有方法的优越性。源代码已公开发布在 https://github.com/SilyRab/AoM。

注：sentiment 在此上下文中翻译为“情感”，aspect-based sentiment analysis 翻译为“基于方面的 sentiment 分析”。但为了更准确地表达原文含义，保留了 sentiment 和 aspect 的英文形式。链接也直接保留未翻译。如果需要完全汉化，可以将 sentiment 改为“情感”，aspect 改为“方面”，并将链接翻译为“https://github.com/SilyRab/AoM”。但是，由于链接通常不进行翻译，这里保持原样。

[No.767] BIC: Twitter Bot Detection with Text-Graph Interaction and Semantic Consistency
来源: ACL 2023
命中: detect
标题: BIC: 基于文本-图互动和语义一致性的人物机器人检测
类别: 
作者: Zhenyu Lei;Herun Wan;Wenqian Zhang;Shangbin Feng;Zilong Chen;Jundong Li;Qinghua Zheng;Minnan Luo;
机构: Xi'an Jiao Tong University;University of Washington;Tsinghua University;University of Virginia;
类型: Long

arXi: https://arxiv.org/abs/2208.08320
英摘: Twitter bots are automatic programs operated by malicious actors to manipulate public opinion and spread misinformation. Research efforts have been made to automatically identify bots based on texts and networks on social media. Existing methods only leverage texts or networks alone, and while few works explored the shallow combination of the two modalities, we hypothesize that the interaction and information exchange between texts and graphs could be crucial for holistically evaluating bot activities on social media. In addition, according to a recent survey (Cresci, 2020), Twitter bots are constantly evolving while advanced bots steal genuine users' tweets and dilute their malicious content to evade detection. This results in greater inconsistency across the timeline of novel Twitter bots, which warrants more attention. In light of these challenges, we propose BIC, a Twitter Bot detection framework with text-graph Interaction and semantic Consistency. Specifically, in addition to separately modeling the two modalities on social media, BIC employs a text-graph interaction module to enable information exchange across modalities in the learning process. In addition, given the stealing behavior of novel Twitter bots, BIC proposes to model semantic consistency in tweets based on attention weights while using it to augment the decision process. Extensive experiments demonstrate that BIC consistently outperforms state-of-the-art baselines on two widely adopted datasets. Further analyses reveal that text-graph interactions and modeling semantic consistency are essential improvements and help combat bot evolution.
中摘: 推特机器人是由恶意行为者操控的自动程序，用于操纵公众舆论和传播虚假信息。研究工作已经致力于根据社交媒体上的文本和网络自动识别这些机器人。现有方法仅单独利用文本或网络，尽管少数研究探索了两种模式的浅层结合，我们假设文本与图之间的互动和信息交换对于全面评估社交媒体上机器人的活动至关重要。此外，根据最近的一项调查（Cresci, 2020），推特机器人在不断进化，而高级机器人通过窃取真实用户发布的推文并稀释其恶意内容来逃避检测，这导致新型推特机器人的时间线上存在更大的不一致性，需要更多的关注。鉴于这些挑战，我们提出了BIC，一种基于文本-图交互和语义一致性的推特机器人检测框架。具体来说，除了分别建模社交媒体上的两种模式外，BIC采用了一个文本-图交互模块，以促进学习过程中跨模式的信息交流。另外，考虑到新型推特机器人的窃取行为，BIC提出基于注意力权重对推文中的一致性进行建模，并将其用于增强决策过程。广泛的实验表明，BIC在两个广泛采用的数据集上始终优于最先进的基线模型。进一步的分析揭示，文本-图的交互和建模语义一致性是关键改进，有助于对抗机器人的进化。

[No.775] Detecting and Mitigating Hallucinations in Machine Translation: Model Internal Workings Alone Do Well, Sentence Similarity Even Better
来源: ACL 2023
命中: detect
标题: 检测和缓解机器翻译中的幻觉：仅从模型内部工作机制出发效果不错，而基于句子相似性的方法则更优
类别: 
作者: David Dale;Elena Voita;Loic Barrault;Marta R. Costa-jussà;
机构: Meta;
类型: Long
链接: https://aclanthology.org/2023.acl-long.3/
arXi: https://arxiv.org/abs/2212.08597
英摘: While the problem of hallucinations in neural machine translation has long been recognized, so far the progress on its alleviation is very little. Indeed, recently it turned out that without artificially encouraging models to hallucinate, previously existing methods fall short and even the standard sequence log-probability is more informative. It means that characteristics internal to the model can give much more information than we expect, and before using external models and measures, we first need to ask: how far can we go if we use nothing but the translation model itself ? We propose to use a method that evaluates the percentage of the source contribution to a generated translation. Intuitively, hallucinations are translations "detached" from the source, hence they can be identified by low source contribution. This method improves detection accuracy for the most severe hallucinations by a factor of 2 and is able to alleviate hallucinations at test time on par with the previous best approach that relies on external models. Next, if we move away from internal model characteristics and allow external tools, we show that using sentence similarity from cross-lingual embeddings further improves these results.
中摘: 尽管神经机器翻译中出现幻觉的问题早已被认识，但迄今为止，在缓解这一问题上的进展却微乎其微。实际上，最近的研究表明，如果不人为鼓励模型产生幻觉，现有方法存在不足，甚至标准序列对数概率也比我们预期的更具信息量。这意味着模型内部特性能够提供的信息远超我们的预期，在使用外部模型和度量之前，我们首先需要问：如果我们仅使用翻译模型本身，能走多远？我们提出了一种评估源语言对生成翻译贡献百分比的方法。直观上讲，幻觉是与源语言“脱离”的翻译，因此可以通过低源语言贡献来识别。这种方法将最严重幻觉的检测准确率提高了两倍，并且在测试时缓解幻觉的效果与依赖外部模型的最佳先前方法相当。接下来，如果我们不再局限于模型内部特征，而是允许使用外部工具，我们展示了利用跨语言嵌入的句子相似性可以进一步改善这些结果。

[No.776] Detecting Edit Failures In Large Language Models: An Improved Specificity Benchmark
来源: ACL 2023

标题: 大型语言模型中的编辑失败检测：一个改进的具体性基准
类别: 
作者: Jason Hoelscher-Obermaier;Julia Persson;Esben Kran;Ioannis Konstas;Fazl Barez;

英摘: Recent model editing techniques promise to mitigate the problem of memorizing false or outdated associations during LLM training. However, we show that these techniques can introduce large unwanted side effects which are not detected by existing specificity benchmarks. We extend the existing CounterFact benchmark to include a dynamic component and dub our benchmark CounterFact+. Additionally, we extend the metrics used for measuring specificity by a principled KL divergence-based metric. We use this improved benchmark to evaluate recent model editing techniques and find that they suffer from low specificity. Our findings highlight the need for improved specificity benchmarks that identify and prevent unwanted side effects.

[No.778] Diffusion Theory as a Scalpel: Detecting and Purifying Poisonous Dimensions in Pre-trained Language Models Caused by Backdoor or Bias
来源: ACL 2023
命中: detect
标题: 扩散理论作为一把解剖刀：检测和净化由后门或偏见引起的预训练语言模型中的有毒维度
类别: 
作者: Zhiyuan Zhang;Deli Chen;Hao Zhou;Fandong Meng;Jie Zhou;Xu Sun;
机构: Peking University;Tencent;
类型: Findings
链接: https://aclanthology.org/2023.findings-acl.157/
arXi: https://arxiv.org/abs/2305.04547
英摘: Pre-trained Language Models (PLMs) may be poisonous with backdoors or bias injected by the suspicious attacker during the fine-tuning process. A core challenge of purifying potentially poisonous PLMs is precisely finding poisonous dimensions. To settle this issue, we propose the Fine-purifying approach, which utilizes the diffusion theory to study the dynamic process of fine-tuning for finding potentially poisonous dimensions. According to the relationship between parameter drifts and Hessians of different dimensions, we can detect poisonous dimensions with abnormal dynamics, purify them by resetting them to clean pre-trained weights, and then fine-tune the purified weights on a small clean dataset. To the best of our knowledge, we are the first to study the dynamics guided by the diffusion theory for safety or defense purposes. Experimental results validate the effectiveness of Fine-purifying even with a small clean dataset.
中摘: 预训练语言模型（PLMs）可能在微调过程中被恶意攻击者注入后门或偏见，从而变得有毒。净化潜在有毒PLMs的核心挑战在于精确地找到有毒维度。为了解决这个问题，我们提出了精细净化方法，该方法利用扩散理论来研究微调的动态过程，以寻找潜在的有毒维度。根据不同维度参数漂移与海森矩阵之间的关系，我们可以检测到动态异常的有毒维度，通过将它们重置为干净的预训练权重进行净化，然后在小型干净数据集上对净化后的权重进行微调。据我们所知，我们是第一个从安全或防御目的出发，研究由扩散理论指导的动态过程的研究团队。实验结果证实了即使在小型干净数据集上，精细净化方法的有效性。

[No.787] Guiding Computational Stance Detection with Expanded Stance Triangle Framework
来源: ACL 2023
命中: detect
标题: 基于扩展立场三角框架的计算性立场检测指导

arXi: https://arxiv.org/abs/2305.19845
英摘: Stance detection determines whether the author of a piece of text is in favor of, against, or neutral towards a specified target, and can be used to gain valuable insights into social media. The ubiquitous indirect referral of targets makes this task challenging, as it requires computational solutions to model semantic features and infer the corresponding implications from a literal statement. Moreover, the limited amount of available training data leads to subpar performance in out-of-domain and cross-target scenarios, as data-driven approaches are prone to rely on superficial and domain-specific features. In this work, we decompose the stance detection task from a linguistic perspective, and investigate key components and inference paths in this task. The stance triangle is a generic linguistic framework previously proposed to describe the fundamental ways people express their stance. We further expand it by characterizing the relationship between explicit and implicit objects. We then use the framework to extend one single training corpus with additional annotation. Experimental results show that strategically-enriched data can significantly improve the performance on out-of-domain and cross-target evaluation.

来源: ACL 2023

标题: 我施放“察知思想”：在《龙与地下城》中学习交流与引导，借助意图和心理理论
类别: 
作者: Pei Zhou;Andrew Zhu;Jennifer Hu;Jay Pujara;Xiang Ren;Chris Callison-Burch;Yejin Choi;Prithviraj Ammanabrolu;

[No.800] Multi-Level Knowledge Distillation for Out-of-Distribution Detection in Text
来源: ACL 2023

In this paper, we analyze the complementary characteristics of both OoD detection methods and propose a multi-level knowledge distillation approach that integrates their strengths while mitigating their limitations. We conduct extensive experiments over multiple benchmark datasets, i.e., CLINC150, SST, ROSTD, 20 NewsGroups, and AG News; showing that the proposed method yields new state-of-the-art performance. A comprehensive comparison with state-of-the-art algorithms demonstrates POE's competitiveness on several text classification benchmarks.

[No.822] Two Heads Are Better Than One: Improving Fake News Video Detection by Correlating with Neighbors
来源: ACL 2023
命中: detect
标题: 两人胜过一人：通过与邻居相关联提高假新闻视频检测效果
类别: 
作者: Peng Qi;Yuyang Zhao;Yufeng Shen;Wei Ji;Juan Cao;Tat-Seng Chua;
机构: Chinese Academy of Sciences;University of Chinese Academy of Sciences;National University of Singapore;
类型: Findings
链接: https://aclanthology.org/2023.findings-acl.756/
arXi: https://arxiv.org/abs/2306.05241
英摘: The prevalence of short video platforms has spawned a lot of fake news videos, which have stronger propagation ability than textual fake news. Thus, automatically detecting fake news videos has been an important countermeasure in practice. Previous works commonly verify each news video individually with multimodal information. Nevertheless, news videos from different perspectives regarding the same event are commonly posted together, which contain complementary or contradictory information and thus can be used to evaluate each other mutually. To this end, we introduce a new and practical paradigm, i.e., cross-sample fake news video detection, and propose a novel framework, Neighbor-Enhanced fakE news video Detection (NEED), which integrates the neighborhood relationship of new videos belonging to the same event. NEED can be readily combined with existing single-sample detectors and further enhance their performances with the proposed graph aggregation (GA) and debunking rectification (DR) modules. Specifically, given the feature representations obtained from single-sample detectors, GA aggregates the neighborhood information with the dynamic graph to enrich the features of independent samples. After that, DR explicitly leverages the relationship between debunking videos and fake news videos to refute the candidate videos via textual and visual consistency. Extensive experiments on the public benchmark demonstrate that NEED greatly improves the performance of both single-modal (up to 8.34% in accuracy) and multimodal (up to 4.97% in accuracy) base detectors. Codes are available in https://github.com/ICTMCG/NEED.
中摘: 短视频平台的普及催生了大量的假新闻视频，这些视频比文字形式的假新闻具有更强的传播能力。因此，自动检测假新闻视频已成为实践中的一项重要对策。以往的工作通常使用多模态信息独立验证每个新闻视频。然而，关于同一事件的不同视角的新闻视频通常会一起发布，其中包含互补或矛盾的信息，因此可以相互评估。为此，我们引入了一个新的、实用的范式，即跨样本假新闻视频检测，并提出了一种新颖的框架，邻域增强型假新闻视频检测（NEED），它整合了属于同一事件的新视频之间的邻域关系。NEED可以轻松地与现有的单样本检测器结合，并通过提出的图聚合（GA）和辟谣修正（DR）模块进一步提升它们的性能。具体而言，基于从单样本检测器获得的特征表示，GA通过动态图聚合邻域信息，以丰富独立样本的特征。之后，DR明确利用辟谣视频与假新闻视频之间的关系，通过文本和视觉一致性来反驳候选视频。在公共基准上的广泛实验表明，NEED显著提高了单模态（准确率最高提高8.34%）和多模态（准确率最高提高4.97%）基础检测器的性能。代码可在https://github.com/ICTMCG/NEED上获取。

[No.824] Understanding Factual Errors in Summarization: Errors, Summarizers, Datasets, Error Detectors
来源: ACL 2023
命中: detect
标题: 理解摘要中的事实错误：错误、摘要生成器、数据集、错误检测器
类别: 
作者: Liyan Tang;Tanya Goyal;Alex Fabbri;Philippe Laban;Jiacheng Xu;Semih Yavuz;Wojciech Kryscinski;Justin Rousseau;Greg Durrett;
机构: University of Texas at Austin;Salesforce;
类型: Long
链接: https://aclanthology.org/2023.acl-long.650/
arXi: https://arxiv.org/abs/2205.12854
英摘: The propensity of abstractive summarization models to make factual errors has been studied extensively, including design of metrics to detect factual errors and annotation of errors in current systems' outputs. However, the ever-evolving nature of summarization systems, metrics, and annotated benchmarks makes factuality evaluation a moving target, and drawing clear comparisons among metrics has become increasingly difficult. In this work, we aggregate factuality error annotations from nine existing datasets and stratify them according to the underlying summarization model. We compare performance of state-of-the-art factuality metrics, including recent ChatGPT-based metrics, on this stratified benchmark and show that their performance varies significantly across different types of summarization models. Critically, our analysis shows that much of the recent improvement in the factuality detection space has been on summaries from older (pre-Transformer) models instead of more relevant recent summarization models. We further perform a finer-grained analysis per error-type and find similar performance variance across error types for different factuality metrics. Our results show that no one metric is superior in all settings or for all error types, and we provide recommendations for best practices given these insights.
中摘: 摘要生成模型倾向于产生事实错误的问题已被广泛研究，包括设计用于检测事实错误的指标以及对当前系统输出中的错误进行注释。然而，摘要系统的不断演变、指标的更新以及注释基准数据集的变化使得事实性评估成为了一个移动的目标，这导致在不同指标之间进行清晰比较变得越来越困难。在这项工作中，我们汇总了来自九个现有数据集的事实性错误注释，并根据底层摘要模型对其进行分层。我们在这一分层基准上比较了最先进的事实性指标的表现，包括最近基于ChatGPT的指标，并展示它们在不同类型摘要模型上的表现存在显著差异。至关重要的是，我们的分析显示，近期在事实检测领域取得的大部分改进是在较旧（前Transformer时代）模型产生的摘要上，而不是在更相关的近期摘要模型上。我们进一步针对每种错误类型进行了更细致的分析，发现对于不同事实性指标，在各种错误类型上的表现差异类似。我们的结果显示，没有任何一个指标在所有情况下或对所有错误类型都表现出优越性，鉴于这些见解，我们提供了最佳实践的建议。

[No.825] VoteTRANS: Detecting Adversarial Text without Training by Voting on Hard Labels of Transformations
来源: ACL 2023
命中: detect
标题: VoteTRANS：无需训练检测对抗文本
类别: 
作者: Hoang-Quoc Nguyen-Son;Seira Hidano;Kazuhide Fukushima;Shinsaku Kiyomoto;Isao Echizen;
机构: KDDI Research, Inc.;National Institute of Informatics;
类型: Findings

英摘: Adversarial attacks reveal serious flaws in deep learning models. More dangerously, these attacks preserve the original meaning and escape human recognition. Existing methods for detecting these attacks need to be trained using original/adversarial data. In this paper, we propose detection without training by voting on hard labels from predictions of transformations, namely, VoteTRANS. Specifically, VoteTRANS detects adversarial text by comparing the hard labels of input text and its transformation. The evaluation demonstrates that VoteTRANS effectively detects adversarial text across various state-of-the-art attacks, models, and datasets.
中摘: 对抗性攻击揭示了深度学习模型中的严重缺陷。更危险的是，这些攻击保留了原始意义并逃避人类识别。现有的检测这些攻击的方法需要使用原始/对抗性数据进行训练。在这篇论文中，我们提出了一种无需训练的检测方法，通过对比预测转换的硬标签进行投票，即VoteTRANS。具体而言，VoteTRANS通过比较输入文本及其转换的硬标签来检测对抗性文本。评估表明，VoteTRANS能有效检测各种最先进的攻击、模型和数据集上的对抗性文本。

[No.829] Zero- and Few-Shot Event Detection via Prompt-Based Meta Learning
来源: ACL 2023
命中: detect
标题: 基于提示的元学习的零样本和少样本事件检测
类别: 
作者: Zhenrui Yue;Huimin Zeng;Mengfei Lan;Heng Ji;Dong Wang;
机构: University of Illinois Urbana-Champaign;
类型: Long
链接: https://aclanthology.org/2023.acl-long.440/
arXi: https://arxiv.org/abs/2305.17373
英摘: With emerging online topics as a source for numerous new events, detecting unseen / rare event types presents an elusive challenge for existing event detection methods, where only limited data access is provided for training. To address the data scarcity problem in event detection, we propose MetaEvent, a meta learning-based framework for zero- and few-shot event detection. Specifically, we sample training tasks from existing event types and perform meta training to search for optimal parameters that quickly adapt to unseen tasks. In our framework, we propose to use the cloze-based prompt and a trigger-aware soft verbalizer to efficiently project output to unseen event types. Moreover, we design a contrastive meta objective based on maximum mean discrepancy (MMD) to learn class-separating features. As such, the proposed MetaEvent can perform zero-shot event detection by mapping features to event types without any prior knowledge. In our experiments, we demonstrate the effectiveness of MetaEvent in both zero-shot and few-shot scenarios, where the proposed method achieves state-of-the-art performance in extensive experiments on benchmark datasets FewEvent and MAVEN.
中摘: 随着新兴在线话题成为众多新事件的来源，检测未见过/罕见的事件类型对现有的事件检测方法构成了难以捉摸的挑战，因为这些方法在训练时仅提供了有限的数据访问。为了解决事件检测中的数据稀缺问题，我们提出了MetaEvent，一种基于元学习的框架，用于零样本和少样本事件检测。具体而言，我们从现有事件类型中采样训练任务，并进行元训练以寻找能快速适应未见任务的最佳参数。在我们的框架中，我们提出使用基于完形填空的提示和触发器感知的软提示器来高效地将输出映射到未见的事件类型上。此外，我们基于最大均值差异（MMD）设计了一个对比元目标，以学习类别分离特征。因此，所提出的MetaEvent可以通过将特征映射到事件类型上而无需任何先验知识，执行零样本事件检测。在我们的实验中，我们展示了MetaEvent在零样本和少样本场景下的有效性，在基准数据集FewEvent和MAVEN上的大量实验中，该方法达到了最先进的性能。

[No.830] ‘Quis custodiet ipsos custodes?’ Who will watch the watchmen? On Detecting AI-generated peer-reviews
来源: EMNLP 2024
命中: detect
标题: “谁来监督这些监督者？”——检测AI生成的同行评审
类别: 
作者: Sandeep Kumar;Mohit Sahu;Vardhan Gacche;Tirthankar Ghosal;Asif Ekbal;
机构: Indian Institute of Technology Patna;Oak Ridge National Laboratory;IIT Jodhpur;
类型: Main
链接: https://aclanthology.org/2024.emnlp-main.1262/
arXi: https://arxiv.org/abs/2410.09770
英摘: The integrity of the peer-review process is vital for maintaining scientific rigor and trust within the academic community. With the steady increase in the usage of large language models (LLMs) like ChatGPT in academic writing, there is a growing concern that AI-generated texts could compromise scientific publishing, including peer-reviews. Previous works have focused on generic AI-generated text detection or have presented an approach for estimating the fraction of peer-reviews that can be AI-generated. Our focus here is to solve a real-world problem by assisting the editor or chair in determining whether a review is written by ChatGPT or not. To address this, we introduce the Term Frequency (TF) model, which posits that AI often repeats tokens, and the Review Regeneration (RR) model, which is based on the idea that ChatGPT generates similar outputs upon re-prompting. We stress test these detectors against token attack and paraphrasing. Finally, we propose an effective defensive strategy to reduce the effect of paraphrasing on our models. Our findings suggest both our proposed methods perform better than the other AI text detectors. Our RR model is more robust, although our TF model performs better than the RR model without any attacks. We make our code, dataset, and model public.
中摘: 同行评审过程的完整性对于维护学术界内的科学严谨性和信任至关重要。随着大型语言模型（如ChatGPT）在学术写作中的稳定增长使用，人们越来越担心人工智能生成的文本可能危及科学出版，包括同行评审。之前的研究集中在通用的人工智能生成文本检测上，或者提出了估计可以由人工智能生成的同行评审比例的方法。我们在这里的重点是解决一个现实世界的问题，即通过帮助编辑或主席判断一篇评论是否由ChatGPT撰写。为此，我们引入了词频（TF）模型，该模型认为人工智能经常重复词汇，以及基于ChatGPT在重新提示时会产生相似输出这一理念的评论再生（RR）模型。我们对这些检测器进行了压力测试，以应对词汇攻击和释义。最后，我们提出了一种有效的防御策略，以减少释义对我们模型的影响。我们的研究结果表明，我们提出的两种方法都优于其他人工智能文本检测器。尽管我们的TF模型在没有攻击的情况下表现优于RR模型，但RR模型更为稳健。我们公开了代码、数据集和模型。

[No.832] A new approach for fine-tuning sentence transformers for intent classification and out-of-scope detection tasks
来源: EMNLP 2024
命中: detect
标题: 一种针对意图分类和超出范围检测任务微调句子变换器的新方法
类别: 
作者: Tianyi Zhang;Atta Norouzian;Aanchan Mohan;Frederick Ducatelle;
机构: Northeastern University;University of Victoria;Cerence Inc;
类型: Industry
链接: https://aclanthology.org/2024.emnlp-industry.68/
arXi: https://arxiv.org/abs/2410.13649
英摘: In virtual assistant (VA) systems it is important to reject or redirect user queries that fall outside the scope of the system. One of the most accurate approaches for out-of-scope (OOS) rejection is to combine it with the task of intent classification on in-scope queries, and to use methods based on the similarity of embeddings produced by transformer-based sentence encoders. Typically, such encoders are fine-tuned for the intent-classification task, using cross-entropy loss. Recent work has shown that while this produces suitable embeddings for the intent-classification task, it also tends to disperse in-scope embeddings over the full sentence embedding space. This causes the in-scope embeddings to potentially overlap with OOS embeddings, thereby making OOS rejection difficult. This is compounded when OOS data is unknown. To mitigate this issue our work proposes to regularize the cross-entropy loss with an in-scope embedding reconstruction loss learned using an auto-encoder. Our method achieves a 1-4% improvement in the area under the precision-recall curve for rejecting out-of-sample (OOS) instances, without compromising intent classification performance.
中摘: 在虚拟助手（VA）系统中，拒绝或重新定向超出系统范围的用户查询非常重要。对于超出范围（OOS）的拒绝，最准确的方法之一是将其与对范围内查询的意图分类任务相结合，并使用基于变换器基句子编码器产生的嵌入相似性的方法。通常，此类编码器通过交叉熵损失针对意图分类任务进行微调。最近的研究表明，虽然这为意图分类任务产生了合适的嵌入，但也倾向于将范围内嵌入分散在整个句子嵌入空间中。这导致范围内嵌入可能与OOS嵌入重叠，从而使得OOS拒绝变得困难。当OOS数据未知时，这个问题会更加严重。为了缓解这一问题，我们的工作提出了一种方法，即使用自动编码器学习的范围内嵌入重构损失来正则化交叉熵损失。我们的方法在拒绝样本外（OOS）实例的精确召回率曲线下的面积上实现了1-4%的提升，同时不损害意图分类性能。

[No.833] A Pointer Network-based Approach for Joint Extraction and Detection of Multi-Label Multi-Class Intents
来源: EMNLP 2024
命中: detect
标题: 基于指针网络的方法进行多标签多类意图的联合提取与检测
类别: 
作者: Ankan Mullick;Sombit Bose;Abhilash Nandy;Gajula Sai Chaitanya;Pawan Goyal;

英摘: In task-oriented dialogue systems, intent detection is crucial for interpreting user queries and providing appropriate responses. Existing research primarily addresses simple queries with a single intent, lacking effective systems for handling complex queries with multiple intents and extracting different intent spans. Additionally, there is a notable absence of multilingual, multi-intent datasets. This study addresses three critical tasks: extracting multiple intent spans from queries, detecting multiple intents, and developing a multi-lingual multi-label intent dataset. We introduce a novel multi-label multi-class intent detection dataset (MLMCID-dataset) curated from existing benchmark datasets. We also propose a pointer network-based architecture (MLMCID) to extract intent spans and detect multiple intents with coarse and fine-grained labels in the form of sextuplets. [No.834] A Survey on Detection of LLMs-Generated Content
来源: EMNLP 2024
命中: detect
标题: LLM生成内容检测调查
类别: 
作者: Xianjun Yang;Liangming Pan;Xuandong Zhao;Haifeng Chen;Linda Ruth Petzold;William Yang Wang;Wei Cheng;
机构: University of California, Santa Barbara;NEC Laboratories America;
类型: finding
链接: https://aclanthology.org/2024.findings-emnlp.572/

英摘: The burgeoning capabilities of advanced large language models (LLMs) such as ChatGPT have led to an increase in synthetic content generation with implications across a variety of sectors, including media, cybersecurity, public discourse, and education. As such, the ability to detect LLMs-generated content has become of paramount importance. We aim to provide a detailed overview of existing detection strategies and benchmarks, scrutinizing their differences and identifying key challenges and prospects in the field, advocating for more adaptable and robust models to enhance detection accuracy. We also posit the necessity for a multi-faceted approach to defend against various attacks to counter the rapidly advancing capabilities of LLMs. To the best of our knowledge, this work is the first comprehensive survey on the detection in the era of LLMs. We hope it will provide a broad understanding of the current landscape of LLMs-generated content detection, offering a guiding reference for researchers and practitioners striving to uphold the integrity of digital information in an era increasingly dominated by synthetic content. 来源: EMNLP 2024
命中: detect
标题: 多语言机器生成文本中的作者混淆检测
类别: 
作者: Dominik Macko;Robert Moro;Adaku Uchendu;Ivan Srba;Jason S Lucas;Michiharu Yamashita;Nafis Irtiza Tripto;Dongwon Lee;Jakub Simko;Maria Bielikova;

arXi: https://arxiv.org/abs/2401.07867
英摘: High-quality text generation capability of recent Large Language Models (LLMs) causes concerns about their misuse (e.g., in massive generation/spread of disinformation). Machine-generated text (MGT) detection is important to cope with such threats. However, it is susceptible to authorship obfuscation (AO) methods, such as paraphrasing, which can cause MGTs to evade detection. So far, this was evaluated only in monolingual settings. Thus, the susceptibility of recently proposed multilingual detectors is still unknown. We fill this gap by comprehensively benchmarking the performance of 10 well-known AO methods, attacking 37 MGT detection methods against MGTs in 11 languages (i.e., 10 $\times$ 37 $\times$ 11 = 4,070 combinations). We also evaluate the effect of data augmentation on adversarial robustness using obfuscated texts. The results indicate that all tested AO methods can cause evasion of automated detection in all tested languages, where homoglyph attacks are especially successful. However, some of the AO methods severely damaged the text, making it no longer readable or easily recognizable by humans (e.g., changed language, weird characters).
中摘: 近期大型语言模型（LLMs）的高质量文本生成能力引发了对其被滥用的担忧（例如，大规模生成/传播虚假信息）。机器生成文本（MGT）的检测对于应对这类威胁至关重要。然而，它容易受到诸如释义等作者身份掩饰（AO）方法的影响，这些方法可能导致MGT逃避检测。迄今为止，这仅在单一语种环境下进行评估。因此，最近提出的多语种检测器的易受攻击性仍然未知。我们通过全面基准测试来填补这一空白，测试了10种知名AO方法的表现，针对11种语言中的37种MGT检测方法进行攻击（即，10×37×11=4,070种组合）。我们还评估了使用掩饰文本的数据增强对对抗性鲁棒性的影响。结果表明，在所有测试的语言中，所有测试的AO方法都能导致自动化检测的逃避，其中同形字攻击尤其成功。然而，某些AO方法严重破坏了文本，使其不再可读或容易被人类识别（例如，改变了语言，出现了奇怪的字符）。

[No.848] DECOR: Improving Coherence in L2 English Writing with a Novel Benchmark for Incoherence Detection, Reasoning, and Rewriting
来源: EMNLP 2024
命中: detect
标题: DECOR：一种新型不连贯检测、推理和重写基准以提高二语英语写作的连贯性
类别: 
作者: Xuanming Zhang;Anthony Diaz;Zixun Chen;Qingyang Wu;Kun Qian;Erik Voss;Zhou Yu;
机构: Columbia University;University of California, Davis;
类型: Main
链接: https://aclanthology.org/2024.emnlp-main.639/
arXi: https://arxiv.org/abs/2406.19650
英摘: Coherence in writing, an aspect that second-language (L2) English learners often struggle with, is crucial in assessing L2 English writing. Existing automated writing evaluation systems primarily use basic surface linguistic features to detect coherence in writing. However, little effort has been made to correct the detected incoherence, which could significantly benefit L2 language learners seeking to improve their writing. To bridge this gap, we introduce DECOR, a novel benchmark that includes expert annotations for detecting incoherence in L2 English writing, identifying the underlying reasons, and rewriting the incoherent sentences. To our knowledge, DECOR is the first coherence assessment dataset specifically designed for improving L2 English writing, featuring pairs of original incoherent sentences alongside their expert-rewritten counterparts. Additionally, we fine-tuned models to automatically detect and rewrite incoherence in student essays. We find that incorporating specific reasons for incoherence during fine-tuning consistently improves the quality of the rewrites, achieving a result that is favored in both automatic and human evaluations.
中摘: 写作连贯性是第二语言（L2）英语学习者经常遇到的难题，对于评估L2英语写作至关重要。现有的自动化写作评价系统主要使用基础的表面语言特征来检测写作中的连贯性。然而，对于检测到的不连贯性进行修正的努力甚少，这可能会极大地帮助寻求提高写作能力的L2语言学习者。为填补这一空白，我们引入了DECOR，一个新颖的基准数据集，包含专家注释，用于检测L2英语写作中的不连贯性，识别其背后的原因，并重写不连贯的句子。据我们所知，DECOR是第一个专门为改进L2英语写作设计的连贯性评估数据集，其特色在于提供了原始不连贯句子及其由专家重写的对应句对。此外，我们微调了模型以自动检测并修正学生作文中的不连贯性。我们发现，在微调过程中结合特定的不连贯原因能持续提升改写质量，在自动和人工评估中均获得了更佳的结果。

[No.850] DetectBench: Can Large Language Model Detect and Piece Together Implicit Evidence?
来源: EMNLP 2024
命中: detect
标题: DetectBench：大型语言模型能否检测并拼凑隐含证据？
类别: 
作者: Zhouhong Gu;Lin Zhang;Xiaoxuan Zhu;Jiangjie Chen;Wenhao Huang;Yikai Zhang;Shusen Wang;Zheyu Ye;Yan Gao;Hongwei Feng;Yanghua Xiao;
机构: 
类型: finding
链接: https://aclanthology.org/2024.findings-emnlp.11/
arXi: https://arxiv.org/abs/2406.12641
英摘: Detecting evidence within the context is a key step in the process of reasoning task. Evaluating and enhancing the capabilities of LLMs in evidence detection will strengthen context-based reasoning performance. This paper proposes a benchmark called DetectBench for verifying the ability to detect and piece together implicit evidence within a long context. DetectBench contains 3,928 multiple-choice questions, with an average of 994 tokens per question. Each question contains an average of 4.55 pieces of implicit evidence, and solving the problem typically requires 7.62 logical jumps to find the correct answer. To enhance the performance of LLMs in evidence detection, this paper proposes Detective Reasoning Prompt and Finetune. Experiments demonstrate that the existing LLMs' abilities to detect evidence in long contexts are far inferior to humans. However, the Detective Reasoning Prompt effectively enhances the capability of powerful LLMs in evidence detection, while the Finetuning method shows significant effects in enhancing the performance of weaker LLMs. Moreover, when the abilities of LLMs in evidence detection are improved, their final reasoning performance is also enhanced accordingly.
中摘: 在推理任务的过程中，从上下文中检测证据是关键的一步。评估并提升大语言模型（LLM）在证据检测方面的能力将加强基于上下文的推理表现。本文提出了一项名为DetectBench的基准测试，用于验证在长篇幅文本中识别和拼接隐含证据的能力。DetectBench包含了3,928个选择题，每个问题平均包含994个词汇单位。每个问题平均包含4.55条隐含证据，而通常需要7.62次逻辑推断才能找到正确答案。为了提升LLM在证据检测上的性能，本文提出了侦探式推理提示（Detective Reasoning Prompt）与微调（Finetune）方法。实验表明，现有LLM在长文本环境中检测证据的能力远逊于人类。然而，侦探式推理提示有效地增强了强大LLM在证据检测方面的能力，而微调方法对较弱的LLM性能提升有显著效果。此外，当LLM在证据检测方面的能力得到提高时，其最终的推理表现也相应地得到了增强。

[No.852] Detecting Errors through Ensembling Prompts (DEEP): An End-to-End LLM Framework for Detecting Factual Errors
来源: EMNLP 2024
命中: detect
标题: 通过集成提示检测错误（DEEP）：一个端到端的大语言模型框架用于检测事实性错误
类别: 
作者: Alex Chandler;Devesh Surve;Hui Su;
机构: University of Texas at Austin;Northeastern University;Fidelity Investments;
类型: Main
链接: https://aclanthology.org/2024.emnlp-main.728/
arXi: https://arxiv.org/abs/2406.13009
英摘: Accurate text summarization is one of the most common and important tasks performed by Large Language Models, where the costs of human review for an entire document may be high, but the costs of errors in summarization may be even greater. We propose Detecting Errors through Ensembling Prompts (DEEP) - an end-to-end large language model framework for detecting factual errors in text summarization. Our framework uses a diverse set of LLM prompts to identify factual inconsistencies, treating their outputs as binary features, which are then fed into ensembling models. We then calibrate the ensembled models to produce empirically accurate probabilities that a text is factually consistent or free of hallucination. We demonstrate that prior models for detecting factual errors in summaries perform significantly worse without optimizing the thresholds on subsets of the evaluated dataset. Our framework achieves state-of-the-art (SOTA) balanced accuracy on the AggreFact-XSUM FTSOTA, TofuEval Summary-Level, and HaluEval Summarization benchmarks in detecting factual errors within transformer-generated text summaries. It does so without any fine-tuning of the language model or reliance on thresholding techniques not available in practical settings.
中摘: 准确的文本摘要是最常见且重要的大型语言模型任务之一，在这种任务中，对整篇文档进行人工审核的成本可能很高，但摘要中的错误成本可能更高。我们提出了通过集合提示检测错误（DEEP）——这是一种端到端的大型语言模型框架，用于检测文本摘要中的事实性错误。我们的框架使用一系列多样化的大型语言模型提示来识别事实上的不一致，将它们的输出视为二元特征，然后输入到集合模型中。随后，我们将集合模型校准，以产生实证上准确的概率，表明文本在事实一致性或无幻觉方面的情况。我们证明了在未针对评估数据集的子集优化阈值的情况下，先前用于检测摘要中事实错误的模型表现显著较差。我们的框架在检测由变换器生成的文本摘要中的事实性错误方面，达到了AggreFact-XSUM FTSOTA、TofuEval Summary-Level和HaluEval Summarization基准测试的最先进（SOTA）平衡准确性水平。它实现了这一点，而无需对语言模型进行任何微调，也不依赖于在实际场景中不可用的阈值技术。

[No.854] Detecting Machine-Generated Long-Form Content with Latent-Space Variables
来源: EMNLP 2024
命中: detect
标题: 基于潜在空间变量检测机器生成的长篇内容
类别: 
作者: Yufei Tian;Zeyu Pan;Nanyun Peng;
机构: University of California, Los Angeles;
类型: finding
链接: https://aclanthology.org/2024.findings-emnlp.608/
arXi: https://arxiv.org/abs/2410.03856
英摘: The increasing capability of large language models (LLMs) to generate fluent long-form texts is presenting new challenges in distinguishing machine-generated outputs from human-written ones, which is crucial for ensuring authenticity and trustworthiness of expressions. Existing zero-shot detectors primarily focus on token-level distributions, which are vulnerable to real-world domain shifts, including different prompting and decoding strategies, and adversarial attacks. We propose a more robust method that incorporates abstract elements, such as event transitions, as key deciding factors to detect machine versus human texts by training a latent-space model on sequences of events or topics derived from human-written texts. In three different domains, machine-generated texts, which are originally inseparable from human texts on the token level, can be better distinguished with our latent-space model, leading to a 31% improvement over strong baselines such as DetectGPT. Our analysis further reveals that, unlike humans, modern LLMs like GPT-4 generate event triggers and their transitions differently, an inherent disparity that helps our method to robustly detect machine-generated texts.
中摘: 大型语言模型（LLM）生成流利长文能力的不断提升，带来了区分机器生成输出与人类撰写内容的新挑战，这对于确保表达的真实性和可信度至关重要。现有的零样本检测器主要关注于词元级分布，这在面对现实世界中的领域变化时显得脆弱，包括不同的提示和解码策略，以及对抗性攻击。我们提出了一种更稳健的方法，将抽象元素，如事件转换，作为关键决策因素，通过在从人类撰写文本中提取的事件或主题序列上训练潜空间模型，来检测机器生成文本与人类文本的区别。在三个不同领域内，原本在词元级别难以区分的机器生成文本，通过我们的潜空间模型可以更好地进行区分，相较于DetectGPT等强大基线方法，性能提升了31%。进一步分析显示，与人类不同，现代LLM如GPT-4在生成事件触发及其转换时存在差异，这种固有的不一致帮助我们的方法稳健地检测出机器生成的文本。

[No.856] Detecting Subtle Differences between Human and Model Languages Using Spectrum of Relative Likelihood
来源: EMNLP 2024

标题: 使用相对可能性谱检测人类语言与模型语言之间的细微差异

英摘: Human and model-generated texts can be distinguished by examining the magnitude of likelihood in language. [No.858] Detection and Measurement of Syntactic Templates in Generated Text
来源: EMNLP 2024
命中: detect
标题: 生成文本中的句法模板检测与测量
类别: 
作者: Chantal Shaib;Yanai Elazar;Junyi Jessy Li;Byron C Wallace;
机构: Northeastern University;Allen Institute for AI;University of Washington;University of Texas at Austin;
类型: Main
链接: https://aclanthology.org/2024.emnlp-main.368/
arXi: https://arxiv.org/abs/2407.00211
英摘: Recent work on evaluating the diversity of text generated by LLMs has focused on word-level features. Here we offer an analysis of syntactic features to characterize general repetition in models, beyond frequent n-grams. Specifically, we define syntactic templates and show that models tend to produce templated text in downstream tasks at a higher rate than what is found in human-reference texts. We find that most (76%) templates in model-generated text can be found in pre-training data (compared to only 35% of human-authored text), and are not overwritten during fine-tuning processes such as RLHF. This connection to the pre-training data allows us to analyze syntactic templates in models where we do not have the pre-training data. We also find that templates as features are able to differentiate between models, tasks, and domains, and are useful for qualitatively evaluating common model constructions. Finally, we demonstrate the use of templates as a useful tool for analyzing style memorization of training data in LLMs.
中摘: 近期关于评估大型语言模型(LLMs)生成文本多样性的工作主要集中在词汇层面特征。在这里，我们提供了句法特征的分析，以表征模型中的普遍重复现象，超越了频繁n元组的范畴。具体而言，我们定义了句法模板，并展示了模型倾向于在下游任务中以比人类参考文本更高的频率生成基于模板的文本。我们发现，在模型生成的文本中，大多数（76%）的模板可以在预训练数据中找到（相比之下，只有35%的人类撰写文本中的模板），并且在诸如RLHF等微调过程中不会被覆盖。这种与预训练数据的联系使我们能够在没有预训练数据的情况下分析模型中的句法模板。我们还发现，作为特征的模板能够区分不同的模型、任务和领域，并且对于定性评估常见模型构建非常有用。最后，我们展示了模板作为一种有用的工具，用于分析LLMs中训练数据风格的记忆情况。

[No.862] ECON: On the Detection and Resolution of Evidence Conflicts
来源: EMNLP 2024
命中: detect
标题: 经济：证据冲突的检测与解决
类别: 
作者: Cheng Jiayang;Chunkit Chan;Qianqian Zhuang;Lin Qiu;Tianhang Zhang;Tengxiao Liu;Yangqiu Song;Yue Zhang;Pengfei Liu;Zheng Zhang;
机构: Hong Kong University of Science and Technology;Amazon;Westlake University;Shanghai Jiao Tong University;
类型: Main
链接: https://aclanthology.org/2024.emnlp-main.447/
arXi: https://arxiv.org/abs/2410.04068
英摘: The rise of large language models (LLMs) has significantly influenced the quality of information in decision-making systems, leading to the prevalence of AI-generated content and challenges in detecting misinformation and managing conflicting information, or "inter-evidence conflicts." This study introduces a method for generating diverse, validated evidence conflicts to simulate real-world misinformation scenarios. We evaluate conflict detection methods, including Natural Language Inference (NLI) models, factual consistency (FC) models, and LLMs, on these conflicts (RQ1) and analyze LLMs' conflict resolution behaviors (RQ2). Our key findings include: (1) NLI and LLM models exhibit high precision in detecting answer conflicts, though weaker models suffer from low recall; (2) FC models struggle with lexically similar answer conflicts, while NLI and LLM models handle these better; and (3) stronger models like GPT-4 show robust performance, especially with nuanced conflicts. For conflict resolution, LLMs often favor one piece of conflicting evidence without justification and rely on internal knowledge if they have prior beliefs.
中摘: 大型语言模型（LLM）的兴起显著影响了决策系统中的信息质量，导致人工智能生成内容的普及以及在检测错误信息和处理相互矛盾的信息，即“证据间冲突”方面的挑战。本研究提出了一种方法来生成多样化的、经过验证的证据冲突，以模拟现实世界中的错误信息场景。我们对这些冲突上的冲突检测方法进行了评估，包括自然语言推理（NLI）模型、事实一致性（FC）模型和大型语言模型（LLM），并分析了LLM在解决冲突时的行为。我们的主要发现包括：（1）NLI和LLM模型在检测答案冲突方面表现出高精度，尽管较弱的模型存在召回率低的问题；（2）FC模型在处理词汇相似的答案冲突上表现挣扎，而NLI和LLM模型在这方面表现得更好；（3）更强的模型如GPT-4在处理细微差别冲突时展现出稳健的性能。在解决冲突方面，LLM经常偏向一方的冲突证据而没有给出理由，并且如果它们有先入为主的信念，会依赖于内部知识。

类别:

英摘: Solidarity is a crucial concept to understand social relations in societies. Using 2,864 manually annotated text snippets (with a cost exceeding 18k Euro), we evaluate large language models (LLMs) like Llama 3, GPT-3.5, and GPT-4. We find that GPT-4 outperforms other LLMs, approaching human annotation quality. 来源: EMNLP 2024

类别:

英摘: In this short paper we propose a data augmentation method for intent detection in zero-resource domains. Existing data augmentation methods rely on few labelled examples for each intent category, which can be expensive in settings with many possible intents. We use a two-stage approach: First, we generate utterances for intent labels using an open-source large language model in a zero-shot setting. Second, we develop a smaller sequence-to-sequence model (the Refiner), to improve the generated utterances. The Refiner is fine-tuned on seen domains and then applied to unseen domains. We evaluate our method by training an intent classifier on the generated data, and evaluating it on real (human) data. We find that the Refiner significantly improves the data utility and diversity over the zero-shot LLM baseline for unseen domains and over common baseline approaches. [No.876] How You Prompt Matters! Even Task-Oriented Constraints in Instructions Affect LLM-Generated Text Detection
来源: EMNLP 2024
命中: detect
标题: 你的提示方式很重要！即使在说明中的任务导向约束也会影响由LLM生成的文本检测。
类别: 
作者: Ryuto Koike;Masahiro Kaneko;Naoaki Okazaki;

arXi: https://arxiv.org/abs/2311.08369
英摘: To combat the misuse of Large Language Models (LLMs), many recent studies have presented LLM-generated-text detectors with promising performance. When users instruct LLMs to generate texts, the instruction can include different constraints depending on the user's need. However, most recent studies do not cover such diverse instruction patterns when creating datasets for LLM detection. In this paper, we reveal that even task-oriented constraints -- constraints that would naturally be included in an instruction and are not related to detection-evasion -- cause existing powerful detectors to have a large variance in detection performance. We focus on student essay writing as a realistic domain and manually create task-oriented constraints based on several factors for essay quality. Our experiments show that the standard deviation (SD) of current detector performance on texts generated by an instruction with such a constraint is significantly larger (up to an SD of 14.4 F1-score) than that by generating texts multiple times or paraphrasing the instruction. We also observe an overall trend where the constraints can make LLM detection more challenging than without them. Finally, our analysis indicates that the high instruction-following ability of LLMs fosters the large impact of such constraints on detection performance.

[No.878] Intent Detection in the Age of LLMs
来源: EMNLP 2024
命中: detect
标题: LLM时代的情感识别
类别: 
作者: Gaurav Arora;Shreya Jain;Srujana Merugu;
机构: Amazon;Indian Institute of Technology Jammu;
类型: Industry
链接: https://aclanthology.org/2024.emnlp-industry.114/
arXi: https://arxiv.org/abs/2410.01627
英摘: Intent detection is a critical component of task-oriented dialogue systems (TODS) which enables the identification of suitable actions to address user utterances at each dialog turn. Traditional approaches relied on computationally efficient supervised sentence transformer encoder models, which require substantial training data and struggle with out-of-scope (OOS) detection. The emergence of generative large language models (LLMs) with intrinsic world knowledge presents new opportunities to address these challenges. In this work, we adapt 7 SOTA LLMs using adaptive in-context learning and chain-of-thought prompting for intent detection, and compare their performance with contrastively fine-tuned sentence transformer (SetFit) models to highlight prediction quality and latency tradeoff. We propose a hybrid system using uncertainty based routing strategy to combine the two approaches that along with negative data augmentation results in achieving the best of both worlds ( i.e. within 2% of native LLM accuracy with 50% less latency). To better understand LLM OOS detection capabilities, we perform controlled experiments revealing that this capability is significantly influenced by the scope of intent labels and the size of the label space. [No.882] Lookback Lens: Detecting and Mitigating Contextual Hallucinations in Large Language Models Using Only Attention Maps
来源: EMNLP 2024
命中: detect
标题: 回溯镜头：仅使用注意力图检测和缓解大型语言模型中的上下文幻觉
类别: 
作者: Yung-Sung Chuang;Linlu Qiu;Cheng-Yu Hsieh;Ranjay Krishna;Yoon Kim;James R. Glass;
机构: Massachusetts Institute of Technology;University of Washington;
类型: Main
链接: https://aclanthology.org/2024.emnlp-main.84/
arXi: https://arxiv.org/abs/2407.07071
英摘: When asked to summarize articles or answer questions given a passage, large language models (LLMs) can hallucinate details and respond with unsubstantiated answers that are inaccurate with respect to the input context. This paper describes a simple approach for detecting such contextual hallucinations. We hypothesize that contextual hallucinations are related to the extent to which an LLM attends to information in the provided context versus its own generations. Based on this intuition, we propose a simple hallucination detection model whose input features are given by the ratio of attention weights on the context versus newly generated tokens (for each attention head). We find that a linear classifier based on these lookback ratio features is as effective as a richer detector that utilizes the entire hidden states of an LLM or a text-based entailment model. The lookback ratio-based detector -- Lookback Lens -- is found to transfer across tasks and even models, allowing a detector that is trained on a 7B model to be applied (without retraining) to a larger 13B model. We further apply this detector to mitigate contextual hallucinations, and find that a simple classifier-guided decoding approach is able to reduce the amount of hallucination, for example by 9.6% in the XSum summarization task.
中摘: 当被要求总结文章或根据一段文字回答问题时，大型语言模型（LLM）可能会产生幻觉，添加未经证实的细节，并给出与输入上下文不准确的答案。本文描述了一种简单的方法来检测此类上下文相关的幻觉。我们假设上下文幻觉与LLM对提供的上下文信息的关注程度与其自身生成内容之间的关系有关。基于这一直觉，我们提出了一种简单的幻觉检测模型，其输入特征由对上下文的关注权重与新生成令牌的比率给出（针对每个注意力头）。我们发现，基于这些回看比率特征的线性分类器与利用LLM完整隐藏状态或基于文本的蕴含模型的更复杂的检测器一样有效。基于回看比率的检测器——Lookback Lens——被发现在不同任务甚至模型之间具有迁移能力，允许在7B模型上训练的检测器无需重新训练即可应用于更大的13B模型。我们进一步将此检测器应用于减轻上下文幻觉，并发现一个简单的分类器引导解码方法能够减少幻觉的数量，例如，在XSum摘要任务中减少了9.6%的幻觉。

英摘: This paper focuses on detecting clickbait posts on the Web. These posts often use eye-catching disinformation in mixed modalities to mislead users to click for profit. To escape detection, malicious creators use tricks to add some irrelevant non-bait content into bait posts, dressing them up as legal to fool the detector. This content often has biased relations with non-bait labels, yet traditional detectors tend to make predictions based on simple co-occurrence rather than grasping inherent factors that lead to malicious behavior. This spurious bias would easily cause misjudgments. To address this problem, we propose a new debiased method based on causal inference. By eliminating the noise that causes bias, we can use invariant and causal factors to build a robust model with good generalization ability. 英摘: Detecting multimodal misinformation, especially in the form of image-text pairs, is crucial. However, the generalizability of detectors trained on synthetic data to real-world scenarios remains unclear due to the distribution gap. To address this, we propose learning from synthetic data for detecting real-world multimodal misinformation through two model-agnostic data selection methods that match synthetic and real-world data distributions. 中摘: 检测多模态虚假信息，特别是在图像和文本对的形式下，至关重要。获取大规模、高质量的真实世界事实核查数据集来训练检测器成本高昂，这导致研究者们转而使用由AI技术生成的合成数据集。然而，由于分布差距，训练于合成数据的检测器在现实场景中的泛化能力尚不明确。为了解决这个问题，我们提出了一种通过模型无关的数据选择方法从合成数据学习以检测真实世界多模态虚假信息的方法，这些方法能够匹配合成数据和真实世界数据的分布。实验表明，我们的方法增强了小型MLLM（13B）在真实世界事实核查数据集上的性能，甚至使其超越了GPT-4V~\cite{GPT-4V}。

[No.898] PaCoST: Paired Confidence Significance Testing for Benchmark Contamination Detection in Large Language Models
来源: EMNLP 2024
命中: detect
标题: PaCoST：配对置信显著性检验在大型语言模型基准污染检测中的应用
类别: 
作者: Huixuan Zhang;Yun Lin;Xiaojun Wan;
机构: Peking University;
类型: finding
链接: https://aclanthology.org/2024.findings-emnlp.97/
arXi: https://arxiv.org/abs/2406.18326
英摘: Large language models (LLMs) are known to be trained on vast amounts of data, which may unintentionally or intentionally include data from commonly used benchmarks. This inclusion can lead to cheatingly high scores on model leaderboards, yet result in disappointing performance in real-world applications. To address this benchmark contamination problem, we first propose a set of requirements that practical contamination detection methods should follow. Following these proposed requirements, we introduce PaCoST, a Paired Confidence Significance Testing to effectively detect benchmark contamination in LLMs. Our method constructs a counterpart for each piece of data with the same distribution, and performs statistical analysis of the corresponding confidence to test whether the model is significantly more confident under the original benchmark. We finally call for new LLM evaluation methods.

[No.903] Pretraining Data Detection for Large Language Models: A Divergence-based Calibration Method
来源: EMNLP 2024
命中: detect
标题: 大型语言模型预训练数据检测：一种基于偏差的校准方法
类别: 
作者: Weichao Zhang;Ruqing Zhang;Jiafeng Guo;Maarten de Rijke;Yixing Fan;Xueqi Cheng;
机构: Chinese Academy of Sciences;University of Chinese Academy of Sciences;Zhongguancun Laboratory;University of Amsterdam;
类型: Main
链接: https://aclanthology.org/2024.emnlp-main.300/
arXi: https://arxiv.org/abs/2409.14781
英摘: As the scale of training corpora for large language models (LLMs) grows, model developers become increasingly reluctant to disclose details on their data. This lack of transparency poses challenges to scientific evaluation and ethical deployment. Recently, pretraining data detection approaches, which infer whether a given text was part of an LLM's training data through black-box access, have been explored. The Min-K\% Prob method, which has achieved state-of-the-art results, assumes that a non-training example tends to contain a few outlier words with low token probabilities. However, the effectiveness may be limited as it tends to misclassify non-training texts that contain many common words with high probabilities predicted by LLMs. To address this issue, we introduce a divergence-based calibration method, inspired by the divergence-from-randomness concept, to calibrate token probabilities for pretraining data detection. We compute the cross-entropy (i.e., the divergence) between the token probability distribution and the token frequency distribution to derive a detection score. We have developed a Chinese-language benchmark, PatentMIA, to assess the performance of detection approaches for LLMs on Chinese text. Experimental results on English-language benchmarks and PatentMIA demonstrate that our proposed method significantly outperforms existing methods. Our code and PatentMIA benchmark are available at https://github.com/zhang-wei-chao/DC-PDD.
中摘: 随着大型语言模型（LLMs）训练语料库规模的扩大，模型开发者越来越不愿意透露其数据细节。这种不透明性给科学评估和伦理部署带来了挑战。最近，人们开始探索预训练数据检测方法，通过黑盒访问来推断给定文本是否是LLM训练数据的一部分。其中，Min-K\% Prob方法已经取得了最先进的成果，它假设非训练样本往往包含少数概率较低的异常词。然而，这种方法的有效性可能有限，因为它倾向于错误分类包含许多由LLMs预测出的高概率常见词的非训练文本。为了解决这个问题，我们引入了一种基于散度的校准方法，灵感来源于“偏离随机性”的概念，以校准用于预训练数据检测的标记概率。我们计算了标记概率分布与标记频率分布之间的交叉熵（即，散度），以得出一个检测分数。我们开发了一个中文基准数据集，PatentMIA，用于评估LLMs在中文文本上的检测方法性能。在英语基准数据集和PatentMIA上的实验结果表明，我们提出的方法显著优于现有方法。我们的代码和PatentMIA基准数据集可在https://github.com/zhang-wei-chao/DC-PDD获取。

[No.905] RAFT: Realistic Attacks to Fool Text Detectors
来源: EMNLP 2024
命中: detect

作者: James Liyuan Wang;Ran Li;Junfeng Yang;Chengzhi Mao;

英摘: Large language models (LLMs) have exhibited remarkable fluency across various tasks. However, their unethical applications, such as disseminating disinformation, have become a growing concern. Although recent works have proposed a number of LLM detection methods, their robustness and reliability remain unclear. In this paper, we present RAFT: a grammar error-free black-box attack against existing LLM detectors. In contrast to previous attacks for language models, our method exploits the transferability of LLM embeddings at the word-level while preserving the original text quality. 链接: https://aclanthology.org/2024.emnlp-main.472/
arXi: https://arxiv.org/abs/2410.07573
英摘: The latest advancements in large language models (LLMs) have sparked interest in their potential for software vulnerability detection. However, there is currently a lack of research specifically focused on vulnerabilities in the PHP language, and challenges in extracting samples and processing persist, hindering the model's ability to effectively capture the characteristics of specific vulnerabilities. In this paper, we present RealVul, the first LLM-based framework designed for PHP vulnerability detection, addressing these issues. By vulnerability candidate detection methods and employing techniques such as normalization, we can isolate potential vulnerability triggers while streamlining the code and eliminating unnecessary semantic information, enabling the model to better understand and learn from the generated vulnerability samples. We also address the issue of insufficient PHP vulnerability samples by improving data synthesis methods. To evaluate RealVul's performance, we conduct an extensive analysis using five distinct code LLMs on vulnerability data from 180 PHP projects. 英摘: Media Storms, dramatic outbursts of attention to a story, are central components of media dynamics and the attention landscape. Despite their significance, there has been little systematic and empirical research on this concept due to issues of measurement and operationalization. We introduce an iterative human-in-the-loop method to identify media storms in a large-scale corpus of news articles. The text is first transformed into signals of dispersion based on several textual characteristics. In each iteration, we apply unsupervised anomaly detection to these signals; each anomaly is then validated by an expert to confirm the presence of a storm, and those results are then used to tune the anomaly detection in the next iteration. We demonstrate the applicability of this method in two scenarios: first, supplementing an initial list of media storms within a specific time frame; and second, detecting media storms in new time periods. We make available a media storm dataset compiled using both scenarios. Both the method and dataset offer the basis for comprehensive empirical research into the concept of media storms, including characterizing them and predicting their outbursts and durations, in mainstream media or social media platforms.
中摘: 媒体风暴，即对某个故事的注意力戏剧性爆发，是媒体动态和注意力景观的核心组成部分。尽管它们意义重大，但由于测量和操作化的问题，关于这一概念的系统性和实证研究却很少。我们引入了一种迭代的人工参与循环方法，用于在大规模新闻文章语料库中识别媒体风暴。首先，根据几种文本特征将文本转换为分散度信号。在每次迭代中，我们将无监督异常检测应用于这些信号；然后由专家验证每个异常，以确认风暴的存在，并将这些结果用于调整下一次迭代中的异常检测。我们在两种情况下展示了这种方法的适用性：首先，补充特定时间框架内初始的媒体风暴列表；其次，在新的时间段内检测媒体风暴。我们提供了一个通过这两种情况编译的媒体风暴数据集。该方法和数据集为全面实证研究媒体风暴的概念提供了基础，包括描述其特征、预测其爆发和持续时间，无论是主流媒体还是社交媒体平台。

[No.912] Self-contradictory reasoning evaluation and detection
来源: EMNLP 2024
命中: detect
标题: 自相矛盾的推理评估与检测
类别: 
作者: Ziyi Liu;Soumya Sanyal;Isabelle Lee;Yongkang Du;Rahul Gupta;Yang Liu;Jieyu Zhao;
